scope: Independent exact-source-hashed geometric and final-size visual review, candidate only; no publication
sourceInterpretation: Q3f is a 30 by 12 cross-section prism, 10 deep, with a centred 10-wide notch reaching 6 above the base. Source shows equal top-left, notch-floor and top-right cross-section widths with double ticks and labels the 6 cm vertical base-to-notch-floor height.

The recorded view projects +z up and right; toward-viewer vector has positive x and y and negative z, placing the A face nearest and revealing top-facing and right-facing sides.
independentVisibility: The complete A perimeter is the nearest cross-section and is solid. The top outer receding edges, right end, left notch wall and back upper boundaries that are exposed/silhouettes are solid. The rear bottom B1–B0, rear left B0–B7, B0–A0, right notch wall B4–B3 and A4–B4 are behind the prism and dashed. On back notch floor B5–B4, the front right notch wall occludes it after 35%: projected x changes from 2.31 to 3.71, and the front wall at x=2.8 intersects at (2.8-2.31)/(3.71-2.31)=0.35. Candidate uses solid B5–(2.8,1.4), then dashed to B4. Remaining connecting/back edges follow the listed computed intervals; no solid/dashed mismatch found.
additionalGeometry: Six short strokes are three source equal-length double-tick groups on front horizontal A7–A6, A5–A4 and A3–A2. The extra vertical double-headed path (1.65,0)–(1.65,0.84), with 6 cm label, is a dimension annotation in the front cross-section, not a model edge or hidden boundary. limitation: Marker/label and page acceptance reported separately by prior reviewer. This result applies only to this exact code, model, camera, source and retained candidate output.
